verdict.rationale: Anytype exposes a documented local API/OpenAPI-derived reference, developer docs site (developers.anytype.io), CLI, and gRPC API with a reference guide for querying/updating spaces, objects, types, and templates 'to build powerful extensions,' plus community examples like the MCP integration built on this API. However, this is framed as an API/automation surface rather than a formal plugin/extension SDK with a plugin lifecycle, packaging, or marketplace, and no independent developer corroboration of building a full plugin was found. missing for 10: a dedicated plugin SDK/framework (vs general API), plugin packaging/distribution mechanism, third-party plugin marketplace, and hands-on independent developer confirmation of building a custom plugin.
